works.name: Software Engineer
works.desc: Building IBM's WatsonX-based enterprise AI agent framework that product teams use to develop and deploy production agents. Engineer A2A communication, artifact exchange and MCP-based tool orchestration for multi-agent handoffs; led the Integration Agent that automates multi-step workflows across enterprise connectors; added end-to-end multimodal image support and the framework's first A2A integration tests; built an agentic Tool Studio with multi-stage LLM validation; and cut Aqua Security CI/CD scanning from 24 hours to under 1 hour.

title: Munch
description: AI restaurant & nutrition discovery app, live on the App Store with hundreds of users — founded and built solo. SwiftUI on a TypeScript/Convex backend with 30+ API modules: an AI pipeline that discovers restaurants, parses HTML/PDF menus and estimates per-dish nutrition with Gemini and Perplexity Sonar, plus HealthKit macro tracking, social feeds and reviews, and RevenueCat subscriptions.
